text: 国家发展改革委10月22日公布新版《对外投资管理办法》，在制度上更好保障对外投资发展和安全。管理办法共76条，分为总则、对外投资指导和服务、对外投资监管、对外投资保护、法律责任、附则等六章。管理办法自2026年12月1日起施行，届时2017年出台的《企业境外投资管理办法》同步废止。
text_en: The National Development and Reform Commission on October 22 published the new "Measures for the Administration of Outbound Investment," providing better institutional safeguards for the development and security of outbound investment. The measures contain 76 articles and are divided into six chapters: general provisions, guidance and services for outbound investment, regulation of outbound investment, protection of outbound investment, legal liability, and supplementary provisions. The measures will take effect on December 1, 2026, at which time the 2017 "Measures for the Administration of Overseas Investment by Enterprises" will be repealed simultaneously.
